notes: First draft of the Workstream-1 tensor-name mapping table (spec 2026-08-08, W1.2). Written as data at Day 0 of the qwen38flashnext rehearsal; the repacker does not read this file yet (FlashNextPlanner hard-codes the same mapping).
SHAPES VERIFIED against ranged shard-header reads at revision de4b8e4d (2026-08-31). Where a shape is given below it came from the real index, not from config arithmetic.
{L} = 0..47 text layers. GDN layers are all L with L % 4 != 3; full-attention layers are L % 4 == 3.

Expert tensors are fused across all 512 experts with gate|up concatenated: gate_up_proj is BF16 [512, 1280, 2560] = [E, 2*moe_intermediate, hidden] and down_proj is [512, 2560, 640] = [E, hidden, moe_intermediate]. The repacker splits them into per-expert page-aligned blobs at install. Which half of the 1280 rows is gate and which is up still needs the reference implementation; it does not affect the byte layout.

PLE GEOMETRY (corrected from the Day-0 estimate): the n-gram table is 128 shards of BF16 [2,500,012 x 160] = 320,001,536 rows x 160 dims, where 16 n-gram heads x 160 = ple_embed_dim 2560. It is NOT a single 20M x 2560 table. 160 is not a multiple of 64, so int4 group-64 cannot quantize these rows: the repacked row pool stores them as BF16 (~102.8 GB), which is why the install is ~175 GB rather than the ~101 GB Day 0 projected.

config.json text_config key names verified: indexer_n_heads, indexer_kv_heads, split_ngram_parts (shard count), ngram_vocab_size_base (PER-HEAD base vocab of 20,000,000 -- not the row count; true totals come from the shard headers).
layer_multipliers is I64 [3]; ngram_heads_offsets and ngram_heads_vocab_sizes are I64 [16]. The repacker carries all three byte-for-byte at dtype I64.

model.visual.* (vision tower) and mtp.* (draft layer) are optional sidecar groups under the W2.4 sidecar policy: vision always skipped, MTP carried by default and dropped with --skip-mtp. The decision is recorded in manifest.json -> sidecars.

resident.model.language_model.layers.{L}.attn_hyp: hcAttnMixDown ([320, 10240]; 10240 = hc_count 4 x hidden 2560, i.e. 4 concatenated residual streams, verified)
resident.model.language_model.layers.{L}.self_att: indexerQKProj (new axis; [640, 2560] fused: 4 q-heads x 128 + 1 kv x 128, verified)

streamed_expert_pool.model.language_model.layers.{L}.mlp.expe: routedExpertGateUp - BF16 [512, 1280, 2560] (verified); split per expert, gate|up halves, page-aligned blob per (layer, expert)

streamed_row_pool.model.language_model.layers.{L}.ple.ple_: pleNgramTable - S = 0..127; BF16 [2,500,012 x 160] per shard, 320,001,536 rows total (verified). Repacked into a page-aligned row-lookup pool (new pool kind, manifest.plePool): rows stay BF16 because 160 is not a multiple of 64; rowStride 320 B, 51 rows per 16 KiB block, one page-aligned region per source shard.

sidecar_mtp.mtp.layers.0.*: one full hybrid draft layer: attn (+indexer), HC pairs, 512-expert MoE with shared expert - same role mapping as the main layer patterns above under the mtp. prefix. Its fused expert tensors go to an additive pool at packed_experts_mtp/ (manifest.auxiliaryExpertPools), outside packed_experts/layout.json.

sidecar_vision_excluded.model.visual.*: SigLIP-style tower (27 blocks, merger, patch/pos embed) — skipped at repack per text-only policy
